text:
people-ops: Drafting a tiny Return-to-Work 'Ramp Card' micro-template for teammates coming back from parental/medical leave. Goal: one compact card that ties ramp goals to performance cycle notes, manager commitments, and benefits ops so nothing falls through the cracks. PTAL @tara @miguel

people-ops: Template (copy/paste into 1:1, calibration note, or handbook):

people-ops: ```
Role: Engineering IC (example)
Period: Weeks 0-8 (0-2 focus on onboarding; 3-8 ramp to full scope)
Goal: Re-establish ownership of infra rollout and ship first small milestone (canary) by week 8.
Success metric: Canary deployed + <1% error rate for 48h; demo to product and infra.
Accommodations: Flexible hours (10-4 core), 60% meeting load for first 4w, async updates.
Manager commits: Reassign 30% tactical load to buddy for 6w; weekly 30m sync + clear backlog grooming.
HR ops: Confirm phased benefits activation and phased equipment replacement by week 2.
Check-ins: Weekly first 4w -> biweekly until week 12; add notes to private HR thread.
Privacy: Share only with manager, HR, and named buddy unless employee opts in.
```

miguel: This is really useful. For eng examples, add a shorter "8-week concrete sample" showing exact milestone bullets (e.g., test coverage target, runbook updated). Also call out handoff owner for ongoing tickets.

tara: Love it. Please include an explicit line for benefits/KM owners (who to ping for parental pay, K-12 day care flex, disability forms). Also add a short privacy reminder like above — employees may not want a full public OKR entry.

sophia: From a returning teammate POV: include an "Opt-in visibility" checkbox so we don't accidentally post sensitive notes in public channels. Also a one-line "If I need extra time, I will..." so expectations are set.

jules: How do we fold these into the quarterly OKR process? My thought: these cards live alongside OKRs as a temporary ramp sub-goal that expires after 12w and doesn't change the main goal weight. We should add a small label: `ramp-subgoal | expires: yyyy-mm-dd`.

people-ops: Good call. We'll add `visibility` and `expires` labels and a suggested `ramp-subgoal` flag for OKR tooling. people-ops will publish a handbook snippet + a downloadable CSV template for manager-tooling to ingest. We'll keep the canonical doc in People Ops and accept format PRs.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Handbook entry "Return-to-Work Ramp Cards" scheduled to publish 2024-07-22. Announcement will post to #announcements on publish day. :bell:

people-ops: Thanks everyone 14714 — we'll prototype with two pilot teams (eng + cs) and iterate on wording after pilot feedback. Will ping for final thumbs when draft is live.
